environmentObservation.detail: A read-only audit command caused uv to rebuild the ignored shared environment; no tracked source or document bytes were modified. The environment is excluded from test or metadata authority for this receipt.

findings.evidence: Opt-in Ruff C901 reported 12 functions; measured maxima were 64, 46, and 42. AST inspection found individual verifier functions of roughly 486-573 lines.
findings.impact: Builder and verifier changes can share omissions; high aggregate coverage does not prove every combined branch is independently checked.
findings.smallestRepairSlice: Without changing semantics, extract scalar, vector, token, terminal-state, and frozen-dependency pure validators; retain current mutation and known-answer tests before enabling a complexity gate.
findings.title: Integrity verifier capsules are too long and branch-complex for safe extension

findings.evidence: Three registries or WeakKeyDictionaries are mutated during calls; resolution also uses id-keyed storage and weakref callbacks. A public verifier is installed dynamically and a bootstrap name is later removed.
findings.impact: Validity depends on interpreter memory and import order. Concurrency is undefined and M3 cross-process resume cannot rely on this implicit state.
findings.smallestRepairSlice: First freeze a single-process and non-thread-safe contract. Then introduce an explicit RuntimeContext or session ownership store with concurrency and cross-process negative tests, and replace global injection with a stable definition or explicit initializer.
findings.title: Object ownership and public verifier installation depend on hidden process state

findings.evidence: Broad TypeError, ValueError, and OverflowError catches return one numeric-failure diagnostic even though the module defines narrower expected numeric and zero-variance exceptions.
findings.impact: Signature drift, invalid dtype handling, or a programming defect can be counted and interpreted as a data-level NOT_EVALUABLE result.
findings.smallestRepairSlice: Map only documented numeric and zero-variance failures plus expected FloatingPointError to analytic failure; propagate or wrap unexpected TypeError and ValueError as V2IntegrityError while preserving the cause.
findings.title: Lagged Pearson can collapse implementation defects into analytic failure

findings.evidence: CSV loading retains whole-file bytes, decoded text, split lines, and column lists. NPZ loading passes whole-file bytes to numpy without member-count, compressed-size, expanded-size, row, element, or total-byte limits. No targeted over-limit or archive-expansion tests were found.
findings.impact: Large CSV or highly compressed NPZ input can exhaust memory before the existing B/C/N calibration execution budget applies.
findings.smallestRepairSlice: Add versioned input byte, row, array element, member, and total expanded-size caps. Validate NPZ names, counts, declared sizes, and CRC before array decoding; fail with ResourceLimitError.
findings.title: CSV and NPZ input loading has no pre-calibration resource caps

findings.evidence: Production calibration uses the private random capsule while ReplicateRandomSource remains exported, and both null modules repeat ownership and token-envelope checks despite a shared owned-transform layer. Current targeted randomness and API tests did not show drift.
findings.impact: A future one-sided repair can split public and production RNG behavior or the two null ownership paths.
findings.smallestRepairSlice: Single-source the seed preimage, rejection primitive, and common owner/token envelope checks. If a second RNG is an independent oracle, internalize and name it as such and retain cross-implementation vectors.
findings.title: Random primitives and null-token envelope validation have duplicated implementations

findings.evidence: NumPy norm, dot, and sum may vary in final bits by BLAS, CPU, or thread reduction path, while backend identity records only NumPy version. No cross-platform counterexample was executed.
findings.impact: Near tie or rejection boundaries, unrecorded backend differences may alter a decision without enough provenance to explain it.
findings.smallestRepairSlice: Record NumPy build, BLAS, CPU, and thread configuration, then add cross-backend boundary vectors or use a fixed-order reduction kernel for decision-critical quantities.
findings.title: Backend identity is insufficient to diagnose cross-platform floating-point boundaries
